messages:
maya: Quick alignment thread  we need final benchmark narrative for launch. Deliverables: hero line, two charts (latency vs $/1k tokens + unit-cost waterfall), gated PDF, webinar outline, inbound routing buckets. EOD Wed?

jon: callout  headline should emphasize predictability not raw speed. Suggest: 'Predictable latency. Predictable spend.'

priya: I'll mock charts: scatter with iso-cost contours + waterfall showing batching/caching/quant steps. Will post by 5pm.

sam: Data note  benchmark covers chat, qna, summarization, code. I'll export median + 95th pct latencies and cost calc per 1k tokens. CSV to /shared/bench by 3pm.

lina: Webinar plan: 25m talk + 10m Q&A. Sections: problem, demo (three routing policies), chart walkthrough, customer CTA.

maya: Inbound rules: CTAs 'Try hosted' and 'Book consult'. Tag leads with estimated monthly tokens. Buckets: <50k -> nurture, 50k-500k -> AE ping, >500k -> SE alert.

jon: Microcopy options: 'Speed you can predict. Costs you can control.' or 'Predictable inference, predictable economics.' I prefer the first.

priya: Agree on first. I'll make two visual variants for A/B: conservative + bold.

ops-bot: Note: staging deploy of landing scheduled 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z.

maya: Quick timeline recap: sam CSV by 3pm, priya mocks by 5pm, landing copy tomorrow a.m., internal review Fri 9am. I'll draft PR/social bullets after visuals. :thumbsup:

jon: I'll draft PDF outline and ROI calculator spec.

lina: I'll write the 3-email drip.

maya: thanks team, post any blockers here.
